leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement a function that accepts an array and chunk size as parameters
Construct a loop to iterate through the original array based on the chunk size
Manipulate array elements to extract subarrays of the specified size
Initialize an empty array to store the resulting chunks
Apply conditional logic to handle edge cases like empty arrays or invalid sizes
Integrate the chunking function into a working JavaScript program
Control the function's output to return an array of arrays as the final result
lessonTitle: Write a function to chunk an array by size
